records.trigger: Explicit behavior-change work: default CLI outputs are context-fattening whales (help alone 46,700 bytes on the story-worktree build; forensics show the milestone table re-printed 3x in one turn) and must become brief by default
records.observedFailure: On baseline HEAD, bare `node bin/lattice.js help` emits 46,700 bytes (~11.7k tokens); the byte-budget probe `test $(node bin/lattice.js help | wc -c) -lt 16000` exits 1. Same class of failure measured for story_list (364,823 bytes), global bug_list (262,917 bytes), finding_list with populated findings (~10.2k tokens), and the milestone-ledger table appended after every mutating command (~8.4k tokens).
records.note: Red probe run 2026-07-12 in the B-7c05 worktree: help bytes: 46700, exit=1. Budget 16000 bytes is the red/green boundary for the help offender; the CHK-005 smoke test enforces per-command budgets for the full offender set.
